content.comment_body: My backup file cannot be opened in [product_name]. The backup was created on a different laptop and I am trying to access it on another device but it's not working. My current software version is [version_no]. I have attached an error screenshot, please review it and help me solve this issue. Thank you in advance.

Please upload your LLD diagram file. I suspect that a specific hardware ([product_name] with [version_no]) was selected in your device configuration. In that case, the diagram cannot be opened with your current software version.

Thank you [user_name] for your support. Please let me know the solution for this issue so that similar situations can be avoided in the future. None of my previously created backups can be accessed and uploading new backups is not possible at the moment. Please advise on a solution. Thank you, [user_name].
I requested you to upload the LLD diagram – please add it here as a ZIP file. I want to check if I am able to open your diagram in my installation of the software.
Okay, I have uploaded the backup for you. Please check the attachment. Thank you.

As suspected, your LLD diagram was created using [product_name] [version_no] and hardware selection [product_name] [version_no]. This prevents opening it with an earlier version of the software. You need at least [product_name] [version_no] installed. It is recommended to update to the latest version, which is currently [product_name] [version_no]. The update is free and can be downloaded from the [company_name] website. However, I am not able to provide the download link right now as the service is temporarily unavailable. Please make sure to select the correct 32 or 64 bit version. Run the Setup.exe as administrator and follow the installation prompts.
Thank you very much. I will proceed to update my software version.

analysis.insight_summary: The user came across a compatibility problem when attempting to open a backup file made in a newer software version on an older one. The software does not provide backward compatibility in these cases, especially for newer hardware setups. This led to important backup files being inaccessible. The discussion highlighted the lack of clear information or warnings regarding software and hardware compatibility, causing workflow issues and user frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the ability to open backup files created on different computers, regardless of software version. The user wants future backup files to always remain accessible and to avoid similar version-related problems.
